meta.name: cobrapy
meta.description: Constraint-based metabolic modeling (COBRA). FBA, FVA, gene knockouts, flux sampling, SBML models, for systems biology and metabolic engineering analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对代谢网络进行约束性建模与通量分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要分析代谢网络、预测基因敲除或进行通量平衡分析。
copy.tagline_en: Perform constraint-based modeling and flux analysis of metabolic networks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze metabolic networks, predict gene knockouts, or perform flux balance analysis.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以用 cobrapy 库加载、构建和导出代谢模型（如 SBML/JSON），并对模型做通量平衡分析、通量可变性分析、基因敲除模拟、通量采样等计算，输出生长速率、必需基因等结果。
howto.when: 当用户提出代谢建模相关任务时触发，例如要求加载或构建代谢模型、做 FBA/FVA 模拟、基因敲除筛查、设计培养基、缺口填补等。

say.text: 用 cobrapy 对 e_coli_core 模型做 FBA，输出生长速率。
对教科书模型做单基因敲除筛查，列表格列出必需基因。
对 iJO1366 模型做 FVA，给出 PFK 和 FBA 的通量范围。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use the cobrapy library to load, build, and export metabolic models (e.g., SBML/JSON), run FBA, FVA, gene knockout screens, flux sampling, and report growth rates and essential genes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for metabolic-modeling tasks, such as loading/building models, running FBA/FVA, gene knockout screens, media design, or gap-filling.

say_en.text: Run FBA on the e_coli_core model with cobrapy and report the growth rate.
Do a single-gene knockout screen on the textbook model and list essential genes.
Run FVA on the iJO1366 model and give flux ranges for PFK and FBA.
